title: Starwake
tagline: A beat-up ship, a few credits, a whole frontier. Trade, hunt, smuggle, or chase the light.
description: Fly a dented freelance hauler through the Calder Reach: twelve star systems linked by jump gates, each with its own star, planets, asteroid fields and stations to dock at. Dogfight from a modelled cockpit with lead indicators, missiles and front/rear shields; run cargo between mining, agricultural, industrial, tech and pirate economies where your trades move the prices; take bounty, escort, patrol and smuggling contracts; upgrade guns, shields, engines, armour, cargo pods and a jump drive, or buy a new hull. Three factions remember what you do, and a five-mission story about your aunt's vanished ship branches on who still trusts you.
controls: Mouse steers (offset from centre), W/S throttle, Shift afterburner, Space/LMB fire, RMB/Ctrl missile, Q/E roll, A/D/R/F strafe, T target, N nav, Z autopilot, C cruise, L dock, J jump, M map, V camera, Esc pause. Gamepad and touch (virtual stick + throttle slider) supported.
fablePass: Music: ambient space score per faction space, combat stingers, docking/hangar theme, finale track
Animation: pilot hands on stick/throttle in cockpit, hangar crane + crew, docking clamps, capital-ship turret slew and breakup sequence
Voice-style comms barks with radio filter
Richer explosion flipbooks and capital-ship debris chunks
